items.summary: بفضل مكتبات NVIDIA CUDA-X الموسعة، بما في ذلك cuPhoton وcuPotential وcuSpa، يمكن للباحثين فرز كميات هائلة من البيانات لتسريع البحث، من الفيزياء الفلكية
items.summaryOriginal: With expanded NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries, including cuPhoton, cuPotential and cuSpa, researchers can sift through vast amounts of data to accelerate research, from astrophysics and materials science to single-cell biology. The speedups are helping scientists analyze larger datasets and model more complex systems. The new libraries give AI agents the tools to help researchers make discoveries […]
